description: This Java source file 'OrderReturnServices.java' contains service methods related to order return processing within the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It includes functionalities such as calculating initial item costs, sending notifications, auto-canceling orders, managing returnable quantities, processing refunds and credits, and creating store credit accounts, among others.

classes.name: OrderReturnServices
classes.description: This class contains static service methods for handling order return processes, including calculation, notifications, cancellations, refunds, and account management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getReturnItemInitialCost
methods.description: Calculates the initial inventory item cost for a specific return item, retrieving data from related inventory and order entities.

methods.name: getOrderAvailableReturnedTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount that can still be returned for an order, considering previous returns and adjustments.

methods.name: sendReturnNotificationScreen
methods.description: Helper method to send various return-related email notifications based on return events.

methods.name: sendReturnAcceptNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification when a return has been accepted.

methods.name: sendReturnCompleteNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification when a return has been completed.

methods.name: sendReturnCancelNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification when a return has been canceled.

methods.name: autoCancelReplacementOrders
methods.description: Automatically cancels replacement orders if the return has not been received within a specified timeframe and sends notifications accordingly.

methods.name: getReturnableQuantity
methods.description: Determines the quantity of a product in an order that is eligible for return, considering product return settings and prior returns.

methods.name: getReturnableItems
methods.description: Returns a map of order items that are eligible for return along with their return quantities and prices.

methods.name: checkReturnComplete
methods.description: Checks the status of return items and updates the return header status accordingly.

methods.name: processCreditReturn
methods.description: Processes a credit (billing account) return, creating necessary financial records and updating return items.

methods.name: createBillingAccountFromReturn
methods.description: Creates a BillingAccount for a return, setting expiration based on store policies, and assigns roles.

methods.name: processRefundReturnForReplacement
methods.description: Handles refund processing specifically for replacement orders, including refund validation and processing.

methods.name: processRefundReturn
methods.description: Processes a refund (cash/charge) return, ensuring the refund amount does not exceed the order total, and manages financial transaction records.

methods.name: processRefundReturn
methods.description: Processes a credit (cash/charge) return by validating the return data, calculating adjustments, handling payments and refunds, updating return item responses, and ensuring the refund does not exceed order totals.

methods.name: refundBillingAccountPayment
methods.description: Handles refunds associated with billing accounts, creating transaction records and linking refunds to the appropriate billing accounts.

methods.name: createPaymentApplicationsFromReturnItemResponse
methods.description: Allocates the response amount across multiple return item billing invoices proportionally, creating payment application records for each invoice involved.

methods.name: processReplacementReturn
methods.description: Creates new replacement orders based on return items, including adjusting items, creating order headers, order items, associations, adjustments, and setting up payment info for replacements.
